# Experimentation Data and Methodology

## References

- [Microsoft: Online Controlled Experiments at Large Scale](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/publication/online-controlled-experiments-at-large-scale/)
- [Google research: Controlled experiments](https://research.google/pubs/pub36500/)
- [Optimizely Stats Engine overview](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410289270157-Stats-Engine-overview)
- [statsmodels documentation](https://www.statsmodels.org/stable/index.html)
- [SciPy statistics documentation](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/stats.html)

## Use

Use these sources for methodology, not as automotive business data. The project’s core experiment outcomes are synthetic or generated by a controlled demo-site experiment.
